source: 2021-4591-65-1005 Rev 0, ST-CGF Topside Fabrication Sequence Drawing (5 sheets, issued for information 13 Apr 2026)
note: Each stage is transcribed from the drawing; tentative dates are the clouded dates on the drawing. 'deck' is where the stage's new work stands, 'parts' says what the model must show as new in the stage (discipline letter and deck code of the zone names: M mechanical, S structure, P piping, E electrical, J instrument, H HVAC, T telecom; MD main, ID intermediate, CD cellar, SD sub-cellar, EH e-house, TSF deck support frame, TSK skidway).
